name: freqtrade-strategies Strategy003
translation_notes: Entry: RSI(14) below 28 (and above 0), close below SMA(40), and EMA(50) above EMA(100). Four features, the plan limit. Dropped from the entry: MFI < 16 (no MFI), fast stochastic fastd > fastk (no stochastic), and the alternative trigger 'EMA(5) crosses above EMA(10)' that the original ORs with the EMA(50) > EMA(100) trend filter (it would need two more features; dropping it gives fewer entries). The original's Fisher-RSI < -0.94 condition is RSI < 32.6 and therefore already implied by RSI < 28, so dropping it loses nothing. Exit as in the Strategy002 seed: Fisher-RSI > 0.3 is exactly RSI > 53.1; 'SAR above close' is approximated by close below the previous close. The ROI table (0 min: 5%, 20: 4%, 30: 3%, 60: 1%) becomes a single 5% take-profit. Stop-loss 10% kept. Timeframe changed 5m -> 1h.
